title: Internal Doors & Joinery
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are frames plumb and square, leaves hung with even gaps?
Ironmongery fitted to schedule, doors closing and latching?
Fire door labels and seals intact where rated?
Gaps between leaf and frame/head 2–4 mm?
Room conditions around 18°C before joinery installed (moisture check)?
Handover / instruction to proceed received and preceding trades complete?
Ask the fitter: What gap are you working to round the leaf, and how is the stop fixed? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Are skirtings, architraves and cornices tight, with clean mitres and no gaps?
Free from damage and ready for decoration?

notOk.t: Door rattles in the keep or does not latch cleanly
Door stops missing or loose; restrictor fixed with wrong screws
Unequal leaf gaps / door not flush at the head
Pin holes in frames and architraves not filled
Skirting: gap to floor, rough paint line, poor joint to shadow gap
Frame chipped, marked or with paint/tape on the face
Shadow gap above the frame uneven or cracked

ask.q: What's the threshold gap above the floor finish?
ask.a: As the door schedule (Riding School spec: 3 mm above floor finish).

ask.q: What's the shadow gap round the frame?
